title: A country profile
description: What a household in the country is offered (PRD 03 §9): the defaults it starts from, and the pointers to the country's own sets of public holidays and document types, which Calendar and Documents define; and the authority its people complain to about their personal data (PRD 05 §3). One file per country, countries/<code>.json. Changing a household's country changes what it is offered from then on, never what it has recorded (FR-HA1).

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, and the file's name: the record's key, the one field without a source. The United Kingdom is GB.

currency.description: The country's currency, ISO 4217: the base currency a household created there starts with.

vat_standard_percent.description: The standard rate of VAT, a decimal percent: the rate a tariff or an expense in the country starts from.

default_units.description: The system of units a household created in the country starts with.

first_day_of_week.description: The day a week starts on in the country, 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday, as JavaScript's Date#getDay and Go's time.Weekday count. A household and each member may override it.

holiday_set.description: The key of the country's set of public holidays, which Calendar offers (plan item 75).

inspection_label.description: The country's own word for the statutory vehicle inspection, shown as it is in every language: the vocabulary changes with the country, not only with the translation.

document_type_set.description: The key of the country's set of document types, which Documents offers (plan item 46).

supervisory_authority.description: The authority a person in the country complains to about how their personal data is handled (GDPR Art. 77), which the privacy centre links to (PRD 05 §3). Where a country has several, the one that says which of them is competent.

name.description: The authority's name. In a language with no established translation of it, its official name in its own language.

url.description: The address of the authority's own page where a person lodges a complaint, or which says how: https, and the same in every language.
